L1: Recommendation: security -> HTTPS + OAuth2 (JWT)
L2: Recommendation: security -> HTTPS + OAuth2 (JWT)
Reasoning: HTTPS is mandatory for secure communication. OAuth2 JWT provides scalable authentication without cloud dependencies, matching lightweight requirements.
Alternatives: API keys, Basic Auth
